housing.summary: Average rent for a 1-bedroom apartment in Umeå city centre is approximately 7,500 SEK/month per Numbeo (Jun 2026). Deposit norm in Sweden is typically 1-3 months rent. Main rental portals are blocket.se (now qasa.se) and hemnet.se.

banking.summary: Major Swedish banks in Umeå include Swedbank, Handelsbanken, SEB, and Nordea. Umeå is a university city with an international community. To open an account newcomers need: valid passport or national ID, Swedish personnummer or samordningsnummer, proof of address, and sometimes proof of student status or employment.
required_docs: Proof of employment or student status (some banks)

schools.summary: Umeå is in Västerbotten County and is home to Umeå University and Umeå Institute of Design. International schools or IB-curriculum options may be limited within the city itself; the Swedish national school directory lists available schools. Families seeking international curricula may need to consider distance learning or travel to larger cities.
curricula: IB (International Baccalaureate) availability limited; check Skolverket directory

legal_admin.summary: All persons moving to Sweden must register with Skatteverket via Folkbokföring (population registration) within 3 months. In Umeå, registration is done at the local Skatteverket service office. Required to receive a personnummer and access public services.

tax_finance.summary: Personnummer is assigned by Skatteverket upon Folkbokföring. It is a 10-digit personal identity number essential for banking, healthcare, employment, and tax matters in Sweden.

transport.summary: Public transport in Umeå is operated by Länstrafiken i Västerbotten (website: tabussen.nu). Monthly pass approximately 570 SEK per Numbeo (Jun 2026). EU/EEA driving licences are valid indefinitely in Sweden; non-EU licences valid 1 year after residency, then exchange required via Transportstyrelsen. Healthcare via Region Västerbotten vårdcentral.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences remain valid in Sweden indefinitely. Non-EU licences valid for 1 year from registration; thereafter exchange required via Transportstyrelsen.
transport.healthcare_registration: Register with a Region Västerbotten vårdcentral (primary care centre) at 1177.se
